finalText:
Found 12 files still on `db.query`, and moved 11 of them to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. All pass a syntax check.

One file, `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, still calls `db.query`. I left it alone on purpose. Its header says it's a vendored copy, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so local edits get silently lost. `lib/db.js` still keeps `db.query` around too, so that file will keep working until the vendor package itself is upgraded.
